cases.input: Open every accepted SurfaceId in desktop and narrow layouts.
cases.expected: Route opens, no console/request loop, existing design preserved, and no new page exists.

cases.input: Supply canonical UNKNOWN truth or missing manifest match.
cases.expected: UNKNOWN is printed; no blank, zero substitution, or green state.

cases.input: Advance injected/runtime time beyond declared evidence maximum age.
cases.expected: STALE or UNKNOWN is visible without a page refresh trick; green is impossible.

cases.input: Keep component expected/instrumented while telemetry becomes silent.
cases.expected: SILENT remains visible in denominator and cannot render green.

cases.input: Remove discovery for an expected component.
cases.expected: MISSING remains in expected denominator and blocks only the canonical dependent posture.

cases.input: Mount synthetic fixture evidence containing adversarial LIVE_PUBLIC claimed-owner fields.
cases.expected: SYNTHETIC_ONLY and WIRED_FIXTURE labels persist; no fixture appears live or green.

cases.input: Make visible + filtered + hidden differ from expected.
cases.expected: Panel is rejected or visibly UNKNOWN; hidden/filtered counts remain shown.

cases.input: Attempt to mount a gauge without owner question, canonical source, denominator, or drill-down.
cases.expected: Contract validation rejects the visual; nothing decorative mounts.

cases.input: Attempt to mount a control without tested backend mutation or before/after ledger proof.
cases.expected: Contract validation rejects the control; unavailable controls show an exact reason.

cases.input: Exercise the accepted kill-switch control contract.
cases.expected: Preview/confirm/result, optimistic revision behavior, before/after state, and ledger evidence are visible.

cases.input: Open incident, trace, and evidence links from every panel family.
cases.expected: Bounded correlated evidence opens and the owner never needs terminal archaeology.

cases.input: Verify Light/Dark, computed type roles, geometry, overflow, and clicks under DESIGN.md ship gate.
cases.expected: Existing visual language remains intact and truth labels are textually unambiguous.

cases.input: Claim 5s detection for a registered failure.

cases.input: Kill the app, host, or tunnel so the browser path cannot report.
cases.expected: Independent out-of-band detector, telemetry, SLO, and proof receipt establish the condition; the dead browser is never treated as proof.
